text:
Simone (PM): hey team, quick sync — we have the release cutoff tomorrow 11:00 PT. need a quick owner for the docsite staging merge and SDK docs regen. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Kevin (Eng): I can handle the SDK regen, give me the PR numbers and the exact branch to target.
Simone (PM): thanks. branch is release/1.6.x. changelog/versions landed earlier today. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-console/pull/2384 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/779
Priya (Docs): the console PR has some console UI copy changes that need a follow-up screenshot update on the docs. I'll prep the screenshots but need the staging deploy window.
Jaime (SRE): staging deploy window is open 09:30–10:30 PT tomorrow. after 10:30 we only do emergency fixes.
Simone (PM): noted. so ideal timeline: merge console PR by 09:15, SDK docs regen + push by 10:00, docs screenshot commit by 10:15, final build and smoke by 10:30. can folks confirm who will merge what? :eyes: 
Kevin (Eng): I'll merge the SDK PR and run the regen. regen command is in repo: `yarn docs:gen && yarn docs:build`. I'll push the doc artifact to the docs branch: `docs/release-1.6`.
Priya (Docs): i'll be on screenshots & quick edits right after the console PR merges. will open a tiny PR for images.
Simone (PM): @Kevin can you also bump the SDK package.json version to 1.6.0 in the regen PR? We want semver final, not rc.
Kevin (Eng): yes will do. quick Q: do we need a manual changelog entry aside from the auto-generated one?
Simone (PM): add a 1-2 line human note under "console: UX" mentioning the two copy tweaks and call out the SDK compat change. keeps release notes clear.
Jaime (SRE): deploy-bot will kick a staging deployment when `main -> staging` merge happens. docs-bot will auto-trigger the site build after the `docs/release-1.6` push.
docs-bot: note: scheduled docs build will run on push to `docs/release-1.6`. Expected build time ~6m.
Kevin (Eng): ack. I'll merge SDK PR ~08:50 PT, regen and push by 09:30 so docs-bot can start.
Priya (Docs): ack, console PR review is ✅ from UX, just awaiting final sign-off from infra. committing screenshots shouldn't take long after merge. :thumbsup:
Simone (PM): thanks — one more thing: if the docs build fails we fallback to embedding the SDK changelog in the Release post and do a manual docs redirect. Jaime, can you keep an eye on the staging deploy?
Jaime (SRE): yep i'll watch. i'll also pin a short canary test: `curl -sS https://staging.docs.redwood.inference/1.6/health | grep OK` after build completes. I'll post results here.
Kevin (Eng): plan B noted. I'll include a short smoke script in the regen PR so it's easier to validate.
Simone (PM): lovely. last ask — please add a one-line checklist comment in each PR noting "docs/regen + screenshots + changelog" so release leads can verify quickly.
Priya (Docs): will do.
Jaime (SRE): reminder: cutoff = 11:00 PT but we lock merges at 10:30 except for deploy-blocking fixes.
Simone (PM): great. thanks all. ping here immediately after merges and docs build starts. :shipit:
deploy-bot: staging deploy triggered for commit 7f8b2d4 (redwood-console). ETA ~4m.
docs-bot: docs build started for branch docs/release-1.6 (job #452). logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/job/452
Kevin (Eng): docs build looks green, pushing small package.json bump now.
Simone (PM): received — thanks everyone, will assemble the release post once all smoke tests come back clean.
